tiers.description: Read-only OBD-II diagnostics. One seat, no schematics, no paid edge features.
Phone and Bluetooth dongle plan: 40 AI diagnoses a month, live-data recording and CSV export in the Android app.
Active UDS for a single technician. 100 AI diagnoses and 25 schematic pages a month.
Shop plan: CAN reverse-engineering, J2534, five seats, 400 AI diagnoses.
Multi-site plan: ten seats across three sites, 1,000 AI diagnoses a month.

app_features.label: Connect a Bluetooth dongle
app_features.what: Bluetooth LE and classic ELM327 dongles.

app_features.label: Read engine codes
app_features.what: Stored, pending and permanent codes from every module that answers.

app_features.label: Readiness monitors
app_features.what: Which emissions self-tests have completed since codes were last cleared.

app_features.label: VIN read and decode
app_features.what: Reads the VIN from the engine computer.

app_features.label: Freeze frame
app_features.what: Sensor values saved when a code was set.

app_features.label: Live data recording and CSV export
app_features.what: Record live data on a road test, even with the screen off, and export it.

app_features.label: Vehicles and jobs
app_features.what: Jobs sync with the web app.

app_features.label: AI diagnosis
app_features.what: Likely causes and next checks from the codes and live data.

app_features.label: Customer report
app_features.what: Share a PDF report from the phone.

app_features.label: Clear codes and service functions
app_features.what: Needs the desktop app's safety checks in this release.

app_features.label: CAN Studio
app_features.what: Raw CAN frames and DBC files, on the desktop app.

app_features.label: J2534 pass-thru
app_features.what: J2534 interfaces through the desktop app.

app_features.label: Key programming
app_features.what: Workshop or Fleet with the IMMO add-on, on the desktop app.
